# sol2go — where Solana meets in person

> A calendar and a newsfeed for the Solana ecosystem: hackathons, conferences and city meetups, plus the wider crypto calendar they sit in. Every entry names the source it came from and the day it was checked against it. Independent publication: not affiliated with the Solana Foundation, not an exchange, not a ticket seller, and not a financial adviser.

How this site works, in five rules:

- **Every fact names where it came from, and when we last looked.** The source prints as text, never as a live link.
- **Nothing is listed on a date we could not confirm.** A date given only as a month is printed as a month.
- **Events and what people build, not prices.** Where a story turns on a market number, that number carries a plain warning that it is not advice.
- **Nothing here is financial advice.** No token is recommended, promoted or rated, and no listing is paid for.
- **A page exists when there is something to put on it.** No empty templates waiting for content.

## What a reader finds here

- [Events](https://sol2go.lol/events/): hackathons, conferences and meetups on dates confirmed with the organiser, with the venue, the format and the registration route where the organiser published them.
- [News](https://sol2go.lol/news/): releases, tooling and programmes — the things that change what a builder can do this month.
- [About](https://sol2go.lol/about/): the rules above, written out at length.

## Where the facts come from

The organiser, or the publication that reported it: the Solana Foundation and solana.com, Colosseum, ETHGlobal, the conference organisers themselves, and the project repositories and release notes. Each entry prints that name and the date it was verified.

What has not been announced is said to be unannounced. A venue nobody has given, an agenda not yet published and a prize pool still to come are three things this site names rather than fills in.

## Events

- [Superteam Canada Community Call — December](https://sol2go.lol/events/superteam-canada-community-call-december-2026/): The last Solana call Superteam Canada has scheduled: 3 December, 17:00 to 17:30 UTC on Discord. Nothing is published beyond it.
- [Blockchain Life 2026](https://sol2go.lol/events/blockchain-life-2026-dubai/): The seventeenth Blockchain Life takes Dubai's Festival Arena on 1 and 2 December: a claimed 15,000 attendees, a new AI Future forum inside it, and the week the region's Solana builders plan around.
- [DigiTec 2026, Yerevan](https://sol2go.lol/events/digitec-2026-yerevan/): Armenia's largest tech event fills the Meridian Expo Center on 20 to 22 November, and with nothing on the Solana Armenia calendar since July it is the next time the country's Web3 community is all in one building.
- [Money Layer — Breakpoint Week](https://sol2go.lol/events/money-layer-breakpoint-week-2026/): Capvise brings its founder-and-fund format to Solana's Breakpoint week: London, 16 November, 18:30 to 22:00, under the heading “Money. Markets. Machines.”
- [Pr1me London — dinner for web3 finance](https://sol2go.lol/events/pr1me-london-dinner-2026/): A Solana Breakpoint-week dinner for web3 accounting and finance, London, 16 November, 19:00 to 22:00 — and the guest list is restricted by job title, in writing.
- [Solana Breakpoint 2026](https://sol2go.lol/events/breakpoint-2026-london/): Solana's flagship conference lands at Olympia London on 15–17 November, its theme the Token Supercycle. Developer tickets are $250, general admission $550, students $100.
- [Scale or Die](https://sol2go.lol/events/scale-or-die-2026/): A one-day Solana engineering conference in London on 14 November, 09:30 to 18:30, the day before Breakpoint opens.
- [Superteam Canada Community Call — November](https://sol2go.lol/events/superteam-canada-community-call-november-2026/): The second of the three Solana calls from Superteam Canada, 5 November, 17:00 to 17:30 UTC on Discord. The clock moves an hour in UTC and the listing does not say why.
- [Solana Summit India](https://sol2go.lol/events/solana-summit-india-2026/): Solana in Mumbai on 2 November, 10:00 to 19:00, in Navpada — four days before ETHGlobal fills the same city.
- [Solana Hacker House — London](https://sol2go.lol/events/solana-hacker-house-london-2026/): Thirteen days of free workspace and Solana workshops in London, 1–12 November, running straight into Breakpoint. Approval required, and capacity is limited.
- [IslandDAO v5](https://sol2go.lol/events/islanddao-v5-2026/): IslandDAO's month-long residency for the Solana ecosystem goes to Latin America for the first time: Florianópolis, 19 October to 11 November, with a hackathon, investor days and a demo day inside it.
- [solanaStartupConnect Ghana](https://sol2go.lol/events/solana-startup-connect-ghana-2026/): Two days at the Accra Digital Centre on 15–16 October, the Solana calendar's West African stop this autumn.
- [Solana Summit Singapore](https://sol2go.lol/events/solana-summit-singapore-2026/): 6 October at the Ritz-Carlton Millenia, 09:00 to 18:00 — and the Solana Capital Forum runs in the same city on the same day.
- [Solana Capital Forum Singapore](https://sol2go.lol/events/solana-capital-forum-singapore-2026/): 6 October in Orchard, 12:00 to 20:00 — a private Solana forum capped at 150 allocators, investors, policymakers and infrastructure providers.
- [Superteam Canada Community Call — October](https://sol2go.lol/events/superteam-canada-community-call-october-2026/): Thirty minutes on Discord on 1 October, 16:00 to 16:30 UTC, hosted by Simon, from the chapter building the Solana ecosystem in Canada. The first of three, a month apart.
- [Buildstation Belgrade](https://sol2go.lol/events/buildstation-belgrade-2026/): Twelve days of free co-working in Belgrade, 1 to 12 October, where Superteam Balkan gathers Solana builders to work on projects for the next hackathon.
- [Solana Summit Korea](https://sol2go.lol/events/solana-summit-korea-2026/): A single Solana day in Seoul on 30 September, 10:00 to 17:00, on Yeoui-daero in the Yeouido financial district.
- [ETHGlobal Tokyo 2026](https://sol2go.lol/events/ethglobal-tokyo-2026/): A three-day in-person hackathon in Tokyo, 25–27 September, with the Pragma Tokyo conference alongside it on the 26th.
- [The Solana Ecosystem Call — September](https://sol2go.lol/events/solana-ecosystem-call-september-2026/): The monthly Solana ecosystem call returns on 24 September, 14:00 to 15:00 UTC — a live show hosted by SOL BROTHERS that would rather be late-night television than a community update.
- [Solana Summit Canada](https://sol2go.lol/events/solana-summit-canada-2026/): Two days in Toronto on 23–24 September at St. Lawrence Market North, the Canadian stop on the Solana Summit circuit.
- [Crypto World's Fair](https://sol2go.lol/events/crypto-worlds-fair-2026/): Colosseum's online hackathon runs four weeks from 14 September to 12 October, across eight ecosystems at once, Solana among them. Winners can take $250,000 from its accelerator.
- [The Future of Finance — Thessaloniki](https://sol2go.lol/events/the-future-of-finance-thessaloniki-2026/): Anodos Labs and Superteam Balkan, the Solana chapter for the region, take over a cruise boat moored by the White Tower on 13 September, 19:30 to 22:00 — the closing party of Thessaloniki International Fair week.
- [Co-Working Fridays: London Chapter](https://sol2go.lol/events/co-working-fridays-london-september-2026/): A free Friday desk at Somerset House, 11 September, 10:00 to 20:00, for anyone building on Solana. The London chapter runs it most weeks.
- [Coworking Fridays Belgrade](https://sol2go.lol/events/coworking-fridays-belgrade-september-2026/): A free Friday desk at the AI Hub on Savska, run by Superteam Balkan for anyone building on Solana. 11 September is the next one; there is one most weeks.
- [Crypto Expo Dubai 2026](https://sol2go.lol/events/crypto-expo-dubai-2026/): The eighth edition takes the Dubai World Trade Centre on 9 and 10 September, pitched at institutions rather than builders: 7,000+ attendees, 100+ exhibitors, 140+ speakers from 40+ countries.
- [Solana Summit Serbia 2026](https://sol2go.lol/events/solana-summit-serbia-2026/): Eastern Europe's largest Solana event took the Sava Congress Center in Belgrade on 26 and 27 August: 1,000+ attendees, 50+ speakers, seven tracks, and free to attend.
- [Solana Armenia Meetup, Yerevan](https://sol2go.lol/events/solana-armenia-meetup-yerevan-july-2026/): 108 people came to the ISTC Foundation on 25 July for two short talks, a CTF prize ceremony and four hours of Armenia's Solana builders in one room.
- [ETHGlobal Lisbon 2026](https://sol2go.lol/events/ethglobal-lisbon-2026/): 800+ hackers, $100,000 in prizes and one rule change: for the first time at an ETHGlobal event, you did not have to start from an empty repository.
- [Solana Frontier Hackathon](https://sol2go.lol/events/solana-frontier-hackathon-2026/): Colosseum's spring Solana competition ran 6 April to 11 May and paid out $250,000 in prizes, with another $250,000 per accelerator place — and no tracks and no bounties at all.

## News

- [Rent came down, and every account is now over-funded](https://sol2go.lol/news/rent-came-down-and-every-account-is-now-over-funded/): Solana cut rent, so every existing account now holds more SOL than it needs. A new Token Program instruction takes the surplus out without closing anything — and this is only phase one of five.
- [Before Solana gets 150ms finality, two gates had to open](https://sol2go.lol/news/before-solana-gets-150ms-finality-two-gates-had-to-open/): Alpenglow targets roughly 150ms finality on Solana against today's 12.8 seconds. Two prerequisite feature gates went live on mainnet in July; the consensus change itself reaches devnet in Agave 4.3.
